periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane, directed towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovaloid geometry with a high aspect ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Substantial tapering towards the ventral-medial point of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Extensive vertical coverage of the scapular and humeral regions.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately 1.5 times the pinna width.

other_distinctive_markers: Non-white, cream-toned pelage on the cranial and ventral regions.
